name: CSS Animation Keyframes Builder
summary: Build @keyframes CSS animations with live preview and copy-ready rules.
description: Define animation name, duration, timing, and keyframe stops with transform and opacity. Preview the motion and copy the full @keyframes block plus animation shorthand.

faqs.question: Can I add more keyframes?
faqs.answer: Edit the default bounce preset offsets and transform values, then copy the generated CSS into your stylesheet.
